summary: The note describes how the town of Rivertown, led by Mayor Ava Chen, introduced the CivicConnect app to involve citizens in public works planning. Features include gamification, collective intelligence tools, monthly virtual town halls, a planned AI system, digital inclusion programs and youth modules. Early metrics show higher citizen satisfaction and faster project approvals, though some seniors and technophobes remain hesitant.
one_line: Rivertown's CivicConnect app uses gamification, virtual town halls, AI and inclusion programs to involve residents in public works planning.
key_facts: Mayor Ava Chen of Rivertown introduced the CivicConnect app as a digital toolkit for citizen engagement in public works planning.
The CivicConnect app has been in use since October 1, 2023 and was designed by tech startup UrbanInnovate.
UrbanInnovate's CEO Jamal Rogers says "technology is the great equalizer" for inclusive community engagement.
CivicConnect gamifies governance: users earn points for participating, which can translate into recognition or small tax incentives.
On September 18, 2023, a record 3,000 Rivertown residents joined a virtual town hall on renovating the historic Mill Park.
Virtual town halls hosted on CivicConnect are now scheduled monthly.
An AI system, soon to be integrated into CivicConnect, will analyze community feedback, simulate project outcomes and predict future maintenance needs.
Rivertown received the "Connect All Residents" grant on November 2, 2023, funding free Wi-Fi hubs, digital literacy workshops and device access.
The "Civic Youth Challenge" module offers quests and educational content to engage school-age users.
Dr. Lila Patel, a professor of urban planning at Rivertown University, describes the collective intelligence approach as weaving individual perspectives into a coherent communal vision.
Some seniors and technophobes are hesitant about the digital approach; retiree Carol Emerson says community workshops have helped.
Initial metrics suggest a sharp uptick in citizen satisfaction and project approval times as 2023 closes.
